mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p INNER JOIN post_hashtags ph ON p.post_id = ph.post_id WHERE ph.hashtag_id = #{hashtagId}
